title: Restore closing a pull request from the review UI
body:
## What

The inbox review pane could not close a normal pull request: "Close as duplicate" only appeared for flagged duplicates. This adds a plain **Close pull request** entry with a confirm step to the pane's More menu, so a maintainer can close any PR from the UI.

## Why

CL-XXXX. Filed from the redesign review: "We lost the ability to close a PR... from the UI."

## How

- `apps/web/src/pages/Inbox.tsx`
  - Added a `Close pull request` More-menu row, `shown: canWrite && !item.canClose`, with `window.confirm("Close this pull request?")`.
  - It reuses the existing `run("close")` write path, so the close posts to GitHub carrying the suggested reply and labels when present.
  - Close rows are exempt from the `row.kind !== primary` filter (they stay mutually exclusive via `shown`), so **Close as duplicate** still renders for flagged duplicates — this was a regression in the first version of this change, caught in review and fixed.
- No hub/vendor/interchange changes.

## Verification

- `bun run check` exit 0
- Web unit tests pass (7/7)
- Code reviewed by an independent reviewer: all CL-XXXX outcomes verified, no remaining defects

Closes CL-XXXX.
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: Restore closing a pull request from the review UI
